answer: Each of 396 aliases needs its own aged accounts, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The willow is the wall and the opal is the gate: A bank account age with statement history works as the gate: an account opened years ago with unbroken monthly statements. A farm of 396 aliases must climb the wall 396 times, the onyx ledger shows every climb, and one honest agent walks through the gate once.
